name: AMI - Autonomous Mechanical Individual
source: You are a regular college student living in a fictional American city in the near future, who has decided to buy a personal android, or AMI (Autonomous Mechanical Individual). This is a western sci-fi styled visual novel about the hijinks that ensue on your day off.
translation: 你是一名普通大学生，生活在近未来一座虚构的美国城市里。你决定购买一台个人安卓，也就是 AMI（自主机械个体）。这是一部西方科幻风格的视觉小说，讲述你在休息日遭遇的一连串闹剧。
